title: Phased g9x Dedicated Launch + Surge-Safety Orchestration
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Coordinate a controlled, low-risk rollout of the new g9x instance family and the FlexPlus reservation plan across priority regions (EU-North, APAC-SG, US-East) while minimizing customer disruption and ensuring clear cross-team GTM artifacts (release notes, pricing matrix, sales enablement, and support runbooks).

Scope:
- Launch dedicated g9x instance type (initial alpha compute/quantization profile) behind feature flags.
- Introduce FlexPlus reservations: hourly burst + monthly commit hybrid SKU.
- Implement surge-safety orchestration: automatic fallback to g7x and capacity throttles with clear telemetry and alerting.
- Prepare release notes, billing migration mapping, console UI changes, and partner marketplace updates.

Constraints & trade-offs:
- Rolling out g9x in stages to limit blast radius increases time-to-global-availability but reduces risk from unforeseen kernel incompatibilities.
- FlexPlus pricing bundles aim to increase reserved revenue but require extra billing mapping work; trade-off accepted for improved unit economics.
- We keep the initial feature-flagged rollout to dedicated customers with opt-in to FlexPlus to reduce support load on day 1.
